Maya: Quick sync -- re: suppression UI. New mock uses 'Quiet period (snooze alerts)'. Ops feedback: 'snooze' feels soft. Can we land on explicit copy?
Ethan: Strongly prefer 'Suppress notifications' or 'Silence alerts'. 'Suppress notifications' reads clearly in lists.
Sophie: Agreed. Also timezone clarity is crucial. The mock shows 'In 10m' which confuses people across regions. Show local end time + UTC small text.
Diego: Accessibility: when a suppression toggles we should aria-live announce 'Notifications suppressed until 5:00 PM PDT'. Keep messages short and consistent with UI copy.
Maya: For the compact pill view what about '[bell-off icon] Suppress notifications 0Ends 5:00 PM PDT'? Icon-only is bad for color-blind users. Add text and ensure icon has aria-hidden=true with a visually-hidden label.
Ethan: Interaction: pressing Enter on the pill should open an inline editor panel (desktop). Make it a role="dialog" and focus the end-time input. Mobile fallback -> full modal.
Sophie: Microcopy: change label 'Until' to 'Ends' in the time dropdown (15m, 1h, 4h, Custom). Default 1h for quick silences.
Diego: Preview overlay must show channel matrix (Email / Slack / PagerDuty) with check marks. Current mock lists only Slack which misleads. Also show 'Created by' in hover.
Maya: Toast copy: instead of 'Suppression removed' use 'Notifications will be delivered immediately' so intent is explicit.
Ethan: Add QA checklist to PR: keyboard order, aria-live, dialog focus trap, color contrast, UTC secondary text, channel matrix populated.
Sophie: Small copy nit: inline editor heading use sentence case 'Suppress notifications' (not Title Case). Also Save button -> 'Save suppression' per Jon's earlier suggestion.
